prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit white-washed courtyard with a pale tiled floor, an arched doorway at normal height, low stone steps and a waist-high wall, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Emirati woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smoky bronze eyes, a soft nude lip, warm golden-tan skin, an elegant composed expression, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in long thick box braids, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large bronze hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a lead pyramid-shaped lump, a tin square-sided cowbell, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a bronze hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered rose-gold rings. Extremely long oval nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a minimal cobalt-blue leather micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, paired with a single wide cobalt-blue leather belt buckled around her chest as her only top, two fingers tall, pulled tightly across the middle of her bust with a silver buckle at the center front and the strap end tucked short, covering only what it must, leaving the curve of her bust visible above and below it, no other garment on her chest, her stomach fully visible below it.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme white ankle-strap stilettos with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Japanese man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, graphic electric-blue eyeliner extended into bold wings, smooth pale skin with a cool undertone, a soft amused smile, bold vivid tangerine-orange hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a bronze square-sided cowbell, a silver hammer head, a silver cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop with a heavy rough tin a small flared temple bell hanging at its end, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten rose-gold hair ornaments. Extra long nails in matching polished malachite.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: full body polished banded malachite fused directly to his own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid stone curving to follow his body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep emerald-green malachite surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID pale-green concentric banding swirling through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. His face stays real living skin and the stone ends cleanly at the neck.
RIGHT Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme thigh-high platform stiletto boots carved from the same malachite, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
